title: Four AM Zimbabwe — EN/SN/ES (Zimbabwe Family)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 80bpm analog tape Shona English Spanish language learning trilingual Zimbabwe dawn heritage
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Before Australia, before the flight, before the gate
There was a farm at four AM in Zimbabwe
The hosho marking time before the clock existed
The ngoma calling the workers to the misted rows

[Verse 2 — Shona (SN)]
Nguva iyi yakanga isati yauya [This time had not yet arrived]
Kwakanga kune rima rakawanda [There was a great darkness]
Hosho yakatanga kubvuma [The hosho began to agree]
Ngoma yakaita kuti vanhu vamuke [The ngoma made the people wake]

[Chorus — English]
Four AM Zimbabwe
The world before the world wakes up
Four AM Zimbabwe
The mbira in the morning cup
Jeff and Jill and Kerri and the farm
Four AM Zimbabwe — still warm

[Bridge — Español]
En Italia tienen el acordeón al amanecer [In Italy they have the accordion at dawn]
En Alemania las campanas de la iglesia llaman a la mañana [In Germany the church bells call the morn]
En Japón el taiko comienza el sol [In Japan the taiko starts the sun]
Pero en Zimbabwe — la mbira es la que llama a la familia [But in Zimbabwe — the mbira calls the family]
Antes de la luz, antes de que el día comience [Before the light, before the day moves in]

[Verse 3 — English]
Ari doesn't know this yet
But someday she will ask why she rises before she needs to
Why the four AM feels like home — even in Australia

[Outro — EN/SN/ES]
Four AM Zimbabwe
Nguva yechina Zimbabwe [Four AM Zimbabwe]
Las cuatro de la madrugada Zimbabwe [Four AM Zimbabwe]
The mbira plays on
